facts: UserService.observe rejects foreign/missing/changed task ownership/context; start uses Scheduler task.start only after validation.
lifecycle.start reuses ready owner; when stopped, at most one UserService.start selection occurs. With consumer-only FG=1 the direct manager._spawn fallback is refused.
connect --setup-receipt returns directly through run_setup; configure_local has one manager.start call. Repeated connect --identity is excluded from this campaign.
Connector connect rejects --non-interactive/--json before setup routing; consumer uses explicit credential-stdin instead.
Canonical setup includes bounded version/protocol probes within auxiliary Job; no model turn is submitted by this setup path.
Operator producer waits for materialization/Finish after printing one-shot key, so producer and consumer must run concurrently.
limits: Three installed tests use fake service/status and prove branches, not an OS race.
Before/after owner checks are observations, not an atomic fence. A possible one Scheduler launch is proposed explicitly; no second ensure or replay.
No service or productive native session may belong to the auxiliary Job; only own CLI/probe processes may be cleaned at its deadline.
